author: nixo.eth
content:
EIPs were proposed in a set window last year and then core devs reviewed each and gave their takes on what was most important to be included. the community was encouraged to also review and participate and let AllCoreDevs know what was important (<https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/community-feedback-on-non-headlining-features-in-glamsterdam/26410> & <https://x.com/nixorokish/status/1985807485798924298>) - this was taken into consideration on the calls where the EIPs were discussed. it's extremely helpful when the community chimes in because, yes, core devs don't always have the best visibility to all the use cases onchain. and they're ultimately the ones writing the code and responsible for it, so they do get the final say

what would have better gotten your attention / gotten your feedback in that process?
